properties.name: reveal:vex:assessment-method

OSV-Scanner matched inventoried packages against complete local NuGet/npm/Maven databases with network access and transitive resolution disabled. vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Security Advisory CVE-2026-70162 - .NET Denial of Service Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Upgrade System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs to 8.0.2 or a supported patched version and repackage the self-contained engines.

analysis.detail: The affected API is EnvelopedCms.Decode on Windows. Static reference inspection of the released engine assemblies and selected NuGet runtime assemblies found no EnvelopedCms caller outside the Pkcs implementation and the System.Security type-forwarding facade. The Reports implementation uses SignedCms.ComputeSignature/Encode for output signing. No Reveal integration path to EnvelopedCms.Decode was identified. Custom host code that decodes CMS envelopes is outside this assessment.

vulnerabilities.description: MySqlConnector: Account password disclosed to a man-in-the-middle in zero-configuration TLS mode (clear-text password sent before certificate is verified)
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Upgrade MySqlConnector to 2.6.1 or later; custom providers using VerifyCA/VerifyFull must configure SslCa until patched.

analysis.detail: The advisory requires VerifyCA or VerifyFull without SslCa. Decompiled released MySqlClient.GetConnectionString creates a MySqlConnectionStringBuilder and never sets SslMode or imports an arbitrary connection string; the released MariaDBProvider inherits MySqlProvider. MySqlConnector 2.3.5 declares Preferred as the SslMode default, and the four engine connector assemblies contain no set_SslMode reference. The advisory explicitly excludes Preferred/Required. Reassess any custom provider that enables VerifyCA/VerifyFull without SslCa; this decision does not assert that Preferred authenticates the server.

vulnerabilities.description: Apache Log4net: Silent log event loss in XmlLayout and XmlLayoutSchemaLog4J due to unescaped XML 1.0 forbidden characters

analysis.detail: The package is introduced by Snowflake.Data. Static reference inspection of the selected runtime and released engines found no XmlLayout or XmlLayoutSchemaLog4J use outside logging implementation assemblies. Reveal ships no configuration enabling those log4net layouts. This decision covers the supplied integration; a host that configures either XML layout must reassess and upgrade to log4net 3.3.0 or later.

vulnerabilities.description: Denial of service in ASP.NET Core

analysis.detail: The System.Private.Uri 4.3.0 entry is dependency-graph metadata, not the implementation used by the assessed .NET 8 runtime. Resolving the released Reveal.Sdk.Data 2.3.2 with CopyLocalLockFileAssemblies=true produced 143 copy-local references and none of the legacy Asn1, Http or RegularExpressions assemblies. The four distributed engine .deps.json files likewise have no runtime asset for the legacy Http/Private.Uri entries; the embedded .NET runtime packs are 8.0.34. This decision assumes a serviced .NET 8 host for the NuGet distribution and does not certify an older/custom host runtime.

vulnerabilities.description: basic-ftp: Uncaught TypeError in MLSD directory-listing parser via __proto__ fact name causes DoS in Client.list()
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Review HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/ALL_PROXY settings and avoid FTP-backed PAC URLs; update the dependency chain when patched.

analysis.detail: basic-ftp is reachable through get-uri -> pac-proxy-agent -> proxy-agent -> @puppeteer/browsers. Reveal downloads a fixed HTTPS browser build, but the released downloader constructs ProxyAgent and honors proxy environment variables, including pac+ftp. get-uri can invoke Client.access, Client.list and Client.downloadTo. The default configuration does not require FTP, but deployment proxy configuration is not controlled by the release artifact, so the required input/configuration cannot be ruled out for every installation. Review FTP-backed PAC configurations and update the transitive dependency when a patched release is available.

vulnerabilities.description: SharpCompress has directory traversal via directory entries in WriteToDirectory (zip slip variant)

analysis.detail: MongoDB.Driver.Core 2.21.0 introduces this package for compression. Inspection of the selected NuGet runtime and all four engine assemblies found WriteToDirectory only inside SharpCompress itself, with no integration caller. The affected directory-extraction API is not invoked by the packaged Reveal/MongoDB compression path.

vulnerabilities.description: extract-zip allows arbitrary file writes through symlink archive entries

analysis.detail: The released PuppeteerUtils.download selects the fixed Chrome Headless Shell build 132.0.6834.110 from the upstream browser distribution and a fixed per-user cache directory. Reveal exposes no archive, archive URL, or extraction path input to this call. The described attacks require substituting a malicious archive for that trusted distribution. Supply-chain compromise or a locally tampered cache is outside this assessment; reassess if custom archive sources are introduced.

vulnerabilities.description: Microsoft Security Advisory CVE-2026-84008 - .NET Denial of Service Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.recommendation: Upgrade System.Security.Cryptography.Pkcs to 8.0.2 or a supported patched version and repackage the self-contained engines.

analysis.detail: The affected API is SignedCms.CheckSignature. The vulnerable package is in the resolved graph and packaged engines. Static inspection found a SignedCms reference in the Windows Microsoft.Data.SqlClient runtime assembly as well as the Reports library. Reports uses ComputeSignature/Encode, but SQL Client attestation/signature-verification reachability has not been excluded for all supported connection configurations. No not_affected claim is made; confirm whether attacker-controlled CMS/X.509 data can reach CheckSignature or update the package.

vulnerabilities.description: Zod can exhaust memory while validating oversized constrained collections

analysis.detail: Zod is introduced through chromium-bidi. The released Reveal Node renderer calls puppeteer.launch with executablePath and args only; it does not select WebDriver BiDi. Inspection of the resolved BrowserLauncher confirms that this Chrome launch creates CdpBrowser unless protocol is explicitly webDriverBiDi. The vulnerable BiDi schema-validation path is therefore not used by the supplied renderer. Reassess custom BiDi integration.

vulnerabilities.description: Snappier has an infinite loop during SnappyStream decompression with malformed framed input

analysis.detail: Decompiled MongoDB.Driver.Core 2.21.0 SnappyCompressor calls Snappy.GetUncompressedLength and Snappy.Decompress block APIs. Static reference inspection found SnappyStream only inside Snappier itself. The affected framed-stream decompression path is not used.
